Results were Smartsuit/Smartglove hardware posts and robotics uses, a TouchDesigner tutorial (ImmersiveHq), a competitor benchmark (Viggle PINOC), Grok replies listing Rokoko Vision as an option, and two pipeline mentions with no verdict.

caveats: 1) X search is algorithmic and login-personalised; Top/Latest tabs surface different slices, so this is a sample, not a census. 2) Heavy paid/creator marketing is visible for almost every tool (Tripo Smart Mesh P2/CLI 'smart way to set it up' threads, Hyper3D Rodin MCP/WorldGen creator wave in Sept 2026, Meshy x Hermes Agent $1 promo, Viggle's launch amplification). Obvious campaign posts were excluded, but some kept posts may still be undisclosed partnerships (e.g. Stefan_3D_AI, maxt3chno, alexfredo87 tags the vendor). 3) Several kept posts mention two tools together without preferring one; those are recorded as 'tie'. Some posts appear under more than one tool when they discuss both. 4) Notes are based on the text visible in search results; long posts collapsed behind 'Show more' were read only as far as shown (one thread was opened in full). 5) Excluded counts are approximate tallies of posts reviewed across overlapping queries, not exact. 6) Sloyd, DeepMotion and Rokoko Vision yielded zero qualifying real-user posts in the 12-month window; absence on X is itself a weak signal of low organic adoption among X-active devs, not evidence about quality. 7) Hunyuan3D posts mostly do not state the version; tagged per post as OPEN WEIGHTS / TENCENT HOSTED / VERSION UNSPECIFIED. 8) Many recent posts are about LLM + Blender MCP workflows where the 3D generator is one step; sentiment recorded only for the listed tool. 9) No posts were liked, replied to or otherwise interacted with; no login wall, rate limit or CAPTCHA was encountered. 10) The coordinator briefly navigated this agent's tab mid-run; the URL was re-checked before every extraction and all data was collected from the intended search pages.
